source: Open-Meteo forecast API (https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast), no key, free tier
window: past 72 h + next 48 h, hourly precipitation, UTC
note: Values are for the Open-Meteo model grid cell containing each named point. Past hours are the model's analysis of what fell (class OBSERVED); future hours are model forecast (class FORECAST). No gauge data is used or claimed.
